tasks.title: Build FHIR Adapter
tasks.description: Implement adapters to consume FHIR JSON payloads from Epic, Cerner, and Meditech.
definition_of_done: Unit tests cover mapping of Patient, Claim, Coverage resources.
Adapter passes integration tests against a mock FHIR server.

tasks.title: Implement Claim Translation
tasks.description: Translate incoming EHR claim payloads into the internal claim verification format used by Abraxas.
definition_of_done: Mapping schema and conversion service implemented.
All unit tests for translation pass.

tasks.title: CI Integration Tests
tasks.description: Add continuous integration to run claim‑verification tests on every PR.
definition_of_done: GitHub Actions workflow creates a build matrix for EHR payloads.
All builds must pass tests and lint.

tasks.title: Performance Baseline
tasks.description: Measure how long it takes to translate 10k claims and run through Abraxas engine.
definition_of_done: Results for 10k synthetic claims are recorded in a metrics document.
Baseline metrics are added to README or a separate cheatsheet.
